data.name: Vanish
data.description: As long as you are maintaining focus, as a swift action you can become invisible as long as you do not move from your location.  If you move while under this effect, you instead are treated as having 50%% concealment if you move less than half your movement, or 20%% concealment if you move more than half your movement.  You can use this ability for %1 rounds per day.  These rounds do not need to be consecutive.|VanishRounds
